positions.as_written: Treat a chronically deficient knee as mechanically different from an acutely injured one, not simply as a later stage.
Measure slope where translation is larger than the injury explains.
Treat the contact shift as the mechanical account of post-traumatic degeneration after cruciate injury, and treat it as only partly addressable.
It restores stability reliably and contact position partially, so counselling about long term joint health should not rest on the first achievement alone.
Repair a ramp lesion alongside reconstruction, on secondary restraint grounds.
Measure slope in revision and in a graft that failed without a new injury.
